# OPORA Civil Network

> > OPORA is Ukraine's leading civil society organization dedicated to election monitoring, democratic governance, parliamentary oversight, and open data advocacy.

Громадянська мережа ОПОРА (Civil Network OPORA) monitors electoral integrity across Ukraine, analyzes voting data, tracks parliamentary activity, and advocates for democratic reforms. Led by experts like Ольга Айвазовська and Володимир Кудрицький, OPORA works with the Central Election Commission (ЦВК) and international partners including the European Union to strengthen Ukraine's democracy during wartime and prepare for post-war elections.

## Key Topics

- Election monitoring and observation
- Electoral integrity and reform
- Post-war democratic governance
- Open electoral data and transparency
- Civil society engagement
- Parliamentary oversight
- Voter registry management
- Local elections (місцеві вибори)
- Central Election Commission (ЦВК)
- EU integration and democratic standards
- Referendum processes
- Social cohesion initiatives
- Civic monitoring tools
- Violent rhetoric tracking
- War impact on democracy

## EU Partnership & Democratic Reforms

- [EU Supports Post-War Democratic Reforms and Electoral Inclusivity in Ukraine](https://oporaua.org/en/eu/eu-supports-post-war-democratic-reforms-and-electoral-inclusivity-in-ukraine-25798): EU funding for OPORA's post-war democratic governance program 2025-2026
- [The European Commission Assessed Ukraine's Reform Progress for 2025](https://oporaua.org/en/eu/the-european-commission-assessed-ukraine-s-reform-progress-for-2025-25853): European Commission report on Ukraine's electoral reform progress in 2025

## Open Electoral Data & Analysis

- [Відкриті виборчі дані. Яку інформацію ОПОРА пропонує зробити доступною](https://oporaua.org/danni/vidkriti-viborchi-dani-iaku-informatsiiu-opora-proponuie-zrobiti-dostupnoiu-20080): OPORA proposals for open electoral data and government transparency
- [Про дані з дільниць на місцевих виборах. Приклад Кривого Рогу 2015.](https://oporaua.org/danni/pro-dani-z-dilnits-na-mistsevikh-viborakh-priklad-krivogo-rogu-2015-22747): Polling station data analysis from Kryvyi Rih 2015 local elections
- [Онлайн-обговорення «Втрачені мандати: як розподіляються депутатські місця після виборів. Приклад Чигирина»](https://oporaua.org/danni/onlain-obgovorennia-vtracheni-mandati-iak-rozpodiliaiutsia-deputatski-mistsia-pislia-viboriv-priklad-chigirina-22900): Online discussion: Mandate distribution in Chyhyryn after 2020 elections
- [Lutsk.rada4you.org: Як депутати Луцькради голосують за важливі  питання для учасників АТО](https://oporaua.org/danni/lutsk-rada4you-org-iak-deputati-lutskradi-golosuiut-za-vazhlivi-pitannia-dlia-uchasnikiv-ato-19507): Lutsk city council deputy voting records on ATO veterans via rada4you.org
